sloka: भ्राता मम महातेजा यवीयान् अतिधार्मिकः ।कुशध्वज इति ख्यातः पुरीम् अध्यवसत् शुभाम् ॥१-७०-२॥
transliteration: bhrātā mama mahātejā yavīyān atidhārmikaḥ ।kuśadhvaja iti khyātaḥ purīm adhyavasat śubhām ॥1-70-2॥

translations.english: "The extremely righteous, renowned and most brilliant Kusadhwaja, my younger brother is (at present) ruling the sacred kingdom of Sankasya, which is like the aerial chariot Pushpaka, with darts planted in water as boundary on the bank of the auspicious, sacred river Ikshumati.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! उन्होंने, एक हजार वर्षों तक मौनत्रत धारण कर परम दुष्कर अतुलित तप किया
